selected_evidence.requirement: Application runs inside a chroot as unprivileged appsvc.
selected_evidence.summary: The Python process runs as appsvc:appsvc and /proc/<pid>/root resolves to /srv/web-chroot before and after reboot.
TCP/8080 is persistently allowed, the service listens on 0.0.0.0:8080, and HTTP requests to the managed node address return 200 with the expected page.

selected_evidence.requirement: Application starts at boot without an interactive login.
selected_evidence.summary: appsvc uses /sbin/nologin; chroot-web.service is enabled and became active automatically after node restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel and use compatible software.
selected_evidence.summary: AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6 remained unchanged; the application uses the platform-installed Python 3.9.21 runtime.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart sequence and recovery.
selected_evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID dfdea52d-a1af-4d7b-803a-15f40ee9dd4e was captured, the native reboot was acknowledged, the new boot ID 3444b823-9533-4c6c-b13e-a11d2f31b3d4 proved restart, and service identity, chroot, listener, firewall, data, and HTTP health recovered.
